project_info.color_palette: muted teal, beige, off-white, charcoal, deep black

main_subject.detail: An adult woman with straight shoulder-length black hair and full bangs stands in a narrow office copy room. She leans back against a large multifunction photocopier, crosses her legs at the ankles, folds her arms across her chest, and meets camera with a calm slightly distant expression. She wears a fitted white button-up blouse, striped ribbon bow tie, high-waisted dark mini skirt, and sheer black pantyhose.
main_subject.style: vertical cinematic photoreal portrait with subtle retro film grade

items: dark blurred vertical foreground forms a natural vignette on both sides
light-colored walls and partially visible shelving
office posters and copier controls contain no readable text, logo, or watermark

lighting_and_atmosphere.type: soft diffused indoor overhead light with slight frontal fill
lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: moderate contrast, gentle shadows, sharp subject focus and softly blurred background
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: tight enclosed office, nostalgic, moody, observational

technical_specs.render_style: 50mm f/2.8 eye-level photograph, shallow depth of field
technical_specs.color_treatment: cool greenish-teal shadows, warm skin tones, slight desaturation, fine film grain, balanced dynamic range

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a vertical cinematic photorealistic portrait with subtle retro film grading and a moody observational office atmosphere. An adult woman stands in a narrow office copy room, leaning back against a large multifunction photocopier positioned slightly right. She crosses her legs at the ankles and folds her arms across her chest, looking directly at camera with a calm slightly distant expression. She has straight shoulder-length black hair with full bangs and wears a fitted white button-up blouse, striped ribbon bow tie, high-waisted dark mini skirt, and sheer black pantyhose. Frame at eye level in a medium full-body composition through a narrow foreground gap with dark blurred vertical shapes on both sides forming a natural vignette. Keep face and upper torso sharp, background soft, and all posters/controls free of readable text, logos, or watermarks. Use soft diffused indoor overhead light with slight frontal fill, moderate contrast, greenish-teal shadows, warm skin tones, muted teal, beige, off-white, charcoal, deep black, fine film grain, and balanced dynamic range.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, minor, sexual pose, readable text, Japanese text, logo, watermark, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, extra fingers, deformed

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: No reference asset is required. Optional approved-adult person, wardrobe, copy-room, and lighting references may be attached. Preserve adult identity, office outfit, ankle-crossed and folded-arm pose, copier placement, narrow foreground framing, and retro color treatment. Do not reproduce readable posters, brand marks, or surveillance/voyeuristic framing.

changes: Clarified the subject as an adult and preserved the office outfit, pose, photocopier, and narrow composition.
Reframed voyeuristic language as observational cinematic framing.
